title: The finite test datum of an auxiliary pair and the theta lift as a conjugate descent
summary: For an auxiliary pair O (a space W of rank r, V = I_n, places M and Q, a character mu): the finite datum Upsilon = auxDatum(O) is a sum of translates of the level indicator (upsilon_eq_sum) and transforms under the level by the characters psi and auxLevelChar (pairWeil_upsilon). The doubled Harish-Chandra parameter paramV(O, ., .) of the weight of O on V; FitsParams(O, l): a parameter l on W matching it. Under FitsParams the polynomial P of the highest vector is a product over the infinite places of joint harmonics with staircase lowest K-types, hence an edge between the discrete-series kernels. Finally the class-sum lift theta(Xi) of a form on V to W is a fixed multiple of the conjugate of the theta descent of conj(F_Xi) with datum P tensor Upsilon.
